name: github
description: GitHub: repository rulesets for the protected branches, GitHub Actions workflows, pull requests with the gh command line.

repository-identity.fills: repository.slug and repository.url of the profile file; the host name is repository.host

repository-address.fills: the web address of the repository from its slug, which the bootstrap writes into repository.url (the compare and tag links of the changelog)

protection-available.fills: detected from the API: the rulesets of the repository are readable, or GitHub answers that they need a public repository or a paid plan

branch-protection.fills: one repository ruleset over the production and the integration branch, and the setting that keeps merged branches

required-checks.fills: the job names of requiredChecks; the aggregator job of the CI template reports on every change

ci-workflow-frame.fills: a workflow that triggers on the protected branches, with concurrency and the change-detection job

pull-request-title-check.fills: the pr-title job of the CI template

pull-requests.fills: gh pr create --draft, gh pr ready, gh pr checks, gh pr list, gh pr merge

release.fills: a workflow on a version tag that checks the version and creates the release from the changelog

values-in-host-files.fills: the branch triggers and the job names of the workflow files

merge-guard.fills: `gh pr merge` is recognised, and the required checks of the pull request are read with `gh pr checks`; `gh pr merge --auto` is recognised, and the base and the head of the pull request are read with `gh pr view`

auto-merge.fills: the repository setting "allow auto-merge", turned on by `harness host protect` (with `host.autoMerge`); `gh pr merge --auto` turns it on for a pull request; the workflow that brings the integration branch into the pull requests waiting on it, which the ruleset requires up to date

reports.fills: the reports of users are GitHub issues: list, search, show, create, comment on and close them with the gh command line; the slug of a framework repository from its address

remote-state.fills: a file of another repository's default branch (`gh api repos/<slug>/contents/<path>`) and its pull requests (`gh pr list --repo <slug> --search`), read without a clone; a failure is returned, not thrown

scaffold-files.fills: `SECURITY.md` (the security policy: the supported versions, how to report in private, what happens to a report), `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the frame of the template with the jobs of the stacks), `.github/workflows/release.yml` and, with `host.protection` and `host.autoMerge`, `.github/workflows/update-branches.yml`

ci-audit.fills: the checks of the security review that read the workflow files: the token's `permissions:` declared (S3-001), actions pinned to a full commit (S2-004), no event text spliced into a `run:` script (S3-005), no `pull_request_target` that checks out the proposed code (S4-018)

enforces.by: `harness check security` finds an action that is not pinned to a full commit (in `harness check all`, so in CI, once `checks.security` is on)
the repository ruleset of `harness host protect`: no direct push, no force-push, no deletion, a pull request for every change
the ruleset requires a pull request
the ruleset forbids deleting the protected branches; the setting that deletes merged branches is off
the ruleset lets administrators bypass only when merging a pull request
the ruleset requires the checks of `requiredChecks`
the ruleset requires the checks of `requiredChecks` before a release or hotfix pull request merges, so a flow cannot cut on a red check
the merge guard of the shell hook refuses `gh pr merge` while a required check is not green
the `pr-title` job checks the pull-request title
